♈ Aries

🔥 Energy: With the sidereal Sun and retrograde Venus together in Libra lighting up your 7th house, and Mars plus exalted Jupiter moving through Cancer in your 4th, today’s fire runs through your closest bonds and your home base. Saturn retrograde in Pisces sits in your 12th, quietly pressing you to release old frustrations. The mood is: renegotiate how you share space, time and decisions with others without losing your own center.

💼 Career: Partnership energy is strong. Clients, collaborators or a key colleague may hold the key to moving something forward. The Libra Sun–Venus asks you to revisit terms, expectations and boundaries in professional agreements—especially where the give-and-take has become lopsided. Mars–Jupiter in your 4th favors working from a stable base: organizing your workspace, clarifying family support for your ambitions, or tackling real-estate or office matters. A diplomatic but firm conversation can turn a vague understanding into a clear pact.

❤️ Love: Relationship mirrors are bright. If you’re attached, the Sun–Venus combo in your 7th can bring both sweetness and the need to talk about what hasn’t felt balanced—who initiates, who compromises, who carries emotional labor. Retrograde Venus makes today ideal for revisiting an old pattern instead of pretending it’s gone. If single, you may reconnect with someone from your past or rethink the kind of partnership you’re truly seeking. Watch how potential partners handle disagreement; that’s your clearest insight.

💰 Money: Jupiter exalted with Mars in your 4th puts focus on family finances, housing costs and long-term security plans. This can be a productive day to review rent or mortgage terms, home improvements, or savings for a move. Sun–Venus in the 7th highlights shared expenses and business partnerships—put numbers in writing and check for fairness. Avoid emotional spending to compensate for domestic tension; channel that drive into building a more solid safety net instead.

🧘 Advice: When you adjust the way you show up in one key relationship, the atmosphere in your entire home and work life starts to shift.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: You don’t have to choose between peace and self-respect—real harmony begins the day you stop abandoning yourself in the name of “we.”
taurus:
♉ Taurus

🔥 Energy: The Libra Sun with your ruler Venus retrograde moves through your 6th house of work and health, while Mars and exalted Jupiter in Cancer activate your 3rd house of effort, learning and communication. Saturn retrograde in Pisces steadies your 11th, making you more serious about which friends and goals are worth your time. Today is about fine-tuning the systems that keep your life running, not rushing grand gestures.

💼 Career: Tasks, schedules and cooperation with coworkers are front and center. The 6th-house focus asks you to re-evaluate how work is divided, how you manage your time, and whether your current routine truly supports quality. Venus retrograde suggests you might renegotiate responsibilities or revive a past skill or role that still has value. Mars–Jupiter in the 3rd give you courage to speak up, propose practical improvements, or finally learn a tool you’ve been avoiding. Small, well-chosen adjustments now can free you from chronic irritations.

❤️ Love: Your heart wants steadiness more than drama. You may express affection through practical help more than romantic flourishes—running an errand for a partner, fixing something, or following through on a promise. If you’re in a relationship, conversations about daily habits, chores and health can strengthen bonds if approached as teamwork instead of criticism. If single, you might feel drawn to someone you see regularly in your everyday environment; attraction grows as you notice reliability and kindness in small actions.

💰 Money: Money links closely to skills and consistency under today’s sky. Review how your current workload translates into income—are there services you provide that could be priced differently, streamlined, or phased out? Mars–Jupiter in the 3rd favor investing modestly in training, software or equipment that genuinely boosts efficiency. Be alert to recurring “tiny” expenses attached to routines—subscriptions, convenience purchases—that no longer serve you. Redirecting even one of these streams can support a bigger goal.

🧘 Advice: Treat every task, however minor, as an opportunity to practice the level of care you want your whole life to rest on.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When your daily actions begin to match your true values, you don’t need motivation—your life itself starts to carry you forward.
gemini:
♊ Gemini

🔥 Energy: The Libra Sun with retrograde Venus lights up your 5th house of creativity, joy and children, while your ruler Mercury joins them in Libra’s airy diplomacy. Mars with exalted Jupiter in Cancer energizes your 2nd house of income and self-worth, and Saturn retrograde in Pisces tests long-term career direction. Today mixes play with practicality: what you love doing is linked to what you can sustainably earn from.

💼 Career: Ideas that feel fun might also be financially meaningful now. The 5th-house emphasis favors creative projects, teaching, design, marketing, or any work requiring originality. Venus retrograde suggests you could refine an older concept, relaunch something with better aesthetics, or revisit a past client. Mars–Jupiter in your 2nd sharpens your desire to be properly compensated—use this drive to clarify rates, define the scope of work, or politely push for terms that respect your contribution. Avoid scattering your talents; choose one promising avenue and develop it deeply.

❤️ Love: Romance has a reflective, expressive tone. If attached, you may feel called to bring more play and affection back into the relationship—planning a date, sharing a creative activity, or simply offering more genuine compliments. Venus retrograde can also bring up old loves or memories; notice what they teach you about your patterns without needing to repeat the past. If single, you’re magnetized towards witty, artistic or intellectually engaging people. Just be mindful of falling for someone who only enjoys the performance but shies away from real consistency.

💰 Money: With Mars and Jupiter in your 2nd, your money moves carry extra momentum. This can support decisive action—negotiating pay, starting a side stream of income, or cutting expenses that don’t align with your priorities. The 5th-house Sun–Venus encourage spending on experiences and creative pursuits; choose those that either enrich your skills or genuinely restore your spirit instead of impulsive treats. Separating “this feels good for an hour” from “this strengthens my life” will prevent regrets.

🧘 Advice: Let your enthusiasm lead, but insist that each new spark finds a clear, simple container before you move to the next.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you stop treating your talents as side notes and start budgeting room for them, they quietly begin to pay you back.
cancer:
♋ Cancer

🔥 Energy: The Libra Sun with retrograde Venus moves through your 4th house of home, roots and inner security, while Mars and exalted Jupiter travel together in your own sign, firing up your sense of direction. Saturn retrograde in Pisces activates your 9th, asking you to clarify what you truly believe in. Today’s emotional tide encourages you to rearrange your foundations so they support the person you’re becoming, not just the person you’ve been.

💼 Career: With Mars–Jupiter in Cancer, others may look to you for initiative and leadership, even if informally. You have both courage and intuition available—use them to make a decision you’ve been postponing. The 4th-house Sun–Venus highlights the link between your home life and professional effectiveness: perhaps your workspace needs reorganization, or a family conversation about your ambitions is overdue. Saturn in the 9th encourages practical planning for study, travel or certification that could elevate your path; sketch the next step rather than waiting for a perfect plan.

❤️ Love: Your heart is both bold and tender today. In relationships, you may crave deeper emotional safety and clearer shared plans. Mars–Jupiter in your sign can make you more direct about your needs; aim to speak from warmth rather than frustration. If attached, home-related topics, living arrangements, or family involvement in your bond might be on the table—strive for solutions that feel nurturing to both of you. If single, you could attract people who sense your caring nature; choose those who appreciate it rather than simply leaning on it.

💰 Money: Financial themes center around home and personal growth. You may consider spending on housing, renovations, or items that make your inner environment calmer and more functional. Mars–Jupiter in your 1st can tempt you into bold purchases; check whether they genuinely increase comfort or are just emotional reactions. Saturn in the 9th supports investments in education, legal matters or meaningful travel, as long as they’re planned with realism. A quiet review of family financial expectations could prevent future misunderstandings.

🧘 Advice: Let your desire to protect and care extend to yourself first; everything you build from that place will be sturdier.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The day you treat your own wellbeing as non‑negotiable, your home and relationships naturally rearrange around that new truth.
leo:
♌ Leo

🔥 Energy: With the Libra Sun—your ruler in sidereal terms of vitality—travelling through your 3rd house alongside retrograde Venus and Mercury, your mind and voice are in the spotlight. Mars with exalted Jupiter in Cancer occupies your 12th house, stirring the unconscious and highlighting the power of what happens behind closed doors. Saturn retrograde in Pisces in your 8th intensifies the need for mature handling of shared responsibilities. Today blends sharp thinking with deep undercurrents.

💼 Career: Communication is your strongest asset now. Emails, meetings, short trips, presentations and negotiations can all be fruitful if you prepare your points clearly. Venus retrograde in the 3rd suggests revising a proposal, re-contacting an old client, or correcting a past misunderstanding. At the same time, Mars–Jupiter in your 12th indicate that invisible work—research, strategy, or clearing hidden inefficiencies—has disproportionate impact. Don’t underestimate the value of a few hours of focused solitude to untangle a complex issue.

❤️ Love: Conversations carry more weight than usual in your relationships. If coupled, you may finally address topics you’ve tiptoed around, from everyday logistics to intimacy concerns. Choose curiosity over defensiveness; your partner might reveal motives you hadn’t considered. If single, you could feel drawn to someone you meet through your neighborhood, siblings, or online interactions. However, with Mars–Jupiter in the 12th, hidden dynamics are possible—take your time to see if words and actions align.

💰 Money: Financially, this is a day to look at agreements and fine print. Saturn in the 8th wants shared finances to be treated with clarity and accountability—whether with a partner, lender, or family member. The Libra emphasis in the 3rd favors renegotiating terms, comparing offers, or updating documents. Watch impulsive late-night or stress spending, as the 12th house activation can blur boundaries. Redirect that urge into planning how to close one lingering financial loop.

🧘 Advice: Speak honestly, but let your quiet observations guide which conversations actually deserve your energy.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you stop explaining yourself to every passing opinion and focus on the few that truly matter, your words regain their power.
virgo:
♍ Virgo

🔥 Energy: The Libra Sun with retrograde Venus and Mercury highlights your 2nd house of resources, priorities and speech, while Mars and exalted Jupiter in Cancer activate your 11th house of networks and long-term hopes. Saturn retrograde in Pisces sits in your 7th, continuing a serious review of how you do partnership. Today’s current invites you to align money, values and the people you share your future with.

💼 Career: Work goals intersect strongly with community. The 11th-house Mars–Jupiter push you to take bolder steps in groups—leading an initiative, joining a professional association, or reconnecting with a mentor. Meanwhile, the 2nd-house Sun–Venus–Mercury combo is ideal for talking about compensation, pricing or role definition. Venus retrograde supports revising old agreements or structures that no longer reflect your worth. Put some numbers around your aspirations: what income, workload and collaboration patterns actually match the life you’re building?

❤️ Love: Saturn in your 7th continues to ask for realism in relationships—seeing who truly shows up and who only says the right things. Today, with the 2nd house lit, themes of self-worth and practical needs in love come into focus. If partnered, you may discuss budgets, shared goals, or how each of you contributes beyond money. If single, you’re likely disinterested in vague promises; you’ll feel more drawn to people whose lives show stability and effort. Don’t downplay your needs just to keep the peace.

💰 Money: This is a potent day for financial recalibration. Use the Libra planets in your 2nd to review your budget, correct an old oversight, or adjust your spending categories so they actually match your current life. Mars–Jupiter in the 11th suggest gains through friends, networks, or digital platforms, but also warn against overcommitting to group expenses. Aim for one clear step: renegotiate a fee, cancel an outdated subscription, or set a specific monthly amount toward a long-range dream.

🧘 Advice: Let your standards for money and partnership quietly rise together; saying “no” to misaligned offers creates room for better fits.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you stop proving your value to people who don’t invest back, your time and money naturally start flowing toward what nourishes you.
libra:
♎ Libra

🔥 Energy: The Sun, Mercury and your ruler Venus retrograde all traveling through your own sidereal sign bring the focus squarely onto you—your body, presence and choices. Mars with exalted Jupiter in Cancer energize your 10th house of career and public standing, while Saturn retrograde in Pisces grounds your 6th house of habits. Today has a “reset” flavor: you’re renegotiating your role in your own life.

💼 Career: Ambition and visibility are heightened. Mars–Jupiter high in your chart can bring opportunities to step into leadership or tackle challenging tasks that showcase your capabilities. Simultaneously, the pile-up in your 1st house invites you to ask: does the way you’re working actually suit who you are now? Venus retrograde might bring back an old project, colleague or title for reconsideration. This is a powerful day to adjust how you present yourself—tone, boundaries, even appearance—to better reflect your true direction.

❤️ Love: With so much activity in your sign, your relationships respond strongly to your inner shifts. If coupled, your partner may notice you asserting preferences you used to soften. That’s not a problem if you pair it with openness to dialogue. Use this transit to state what feels nourishing in partnership now, not just what once did. If single, you may attract attention more easily; just remember that retrograde Venus favors reconnecting with your own heart before rushing into something new. The more honest you are about your needs, the clearer your choices become.

💰 Money: Career developments and self-image adjustments tie directly into finances. You might consider asking for a raise, adjusting rates, or positioning yourself for roles that value your diplomacy and judgment more fully. Saturn in the 6th reminds you that sustainable income comes from sustainable habits; small improvements in time management or health can indirectly boost earnings. Be cautious about aesthetic or image-related spending today—invest in what truly supports your path, not just what looks impressive.

🧘 Advice: Give yourself permission to outgrow an old version of “nice” that cost you too much energy.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The moment you stop shaping yourself around other people’s comfort, your natural charm stops being a costume and starts becoming power.
scorpio:
♏ Scorpio

🔥 Energy: The Libra Sun with retrograde Venus and Mercury falls in your 12th house of rest, solitude and closure, while Mars—your traditional ruler—and exalted Jupiter in Cancer activate your 9th house of perspective, learning and faith. Saturn retrograde in Pisces works on your 5th house of joy and self-expression. Today is about withdrawing just enough to see your life with fresh eyes.

💼 Career: Even if you’re busy outwardly, the most important moves now are internal. The 12th-house emphasis favors background work: strategy, research, tying up old obligations, or gently stepping away from a role that’s run its course. Mars–Jupiter in the 9th encourage you to think bigger about your path—training, publishing, teaching, or international connections may beckon. You don’t have to decide everything today, but you can admit which chapter is quietly ending and which new direction excites you.

❤️ Love: Your emotional world is more private than usual. You might be processing old relationship memories, dreams or subtle disappointments that never got words. If partnered, share selectively—this isn’t about unloading everything, but about naming one or two truths that would help your partner understand you better. If single, you may feel less inclined toward new encounters and more drawn to healing patterns that keep repeating. Quiet honesty with yourself now sets the tone for healthier bonds later.

💰 Money: Financially, it’s time to look at the hidden layers—subscriptions you forgot about, quiet anxieties you haven’t faced, or support you give that isn’t acknowledged. The 12th-house Sun–Venus can reveal where money is slipping through cracks, especially due to avoidance or over-giving. Mars–Jupiter in the 9th support learning about investments, taxes, or legal matters that will matter in the long run. Don’t rush into risky schemes; aim to increase understanding before increasing exposure.

🧘 Advice: Protect pockets of silence today; answers you’ve been chasing might surface when you finally stop pushing.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you dare to end what quietly drains you, you don’t lose stability—you clear the ground for a life that actually fits.
sagittarius:
♐ Sagittarius

🔥 Energy: The Libra Sun with retrograde Venus and Mercury lights up your 11th house of friendships, networks and future plans, while your ruler Jupiter exalted in Cancer joins Mars in your 8th, stirring deep emotional and financial currents. Saturn retrograde in Pisces in your 4th presses you to take inner security seriously. Today, conversations about “what’s next” carry real weight.

💼 Career: Group endeavors and long-term goals are favored. You may reconnect with colleagues or communities that were important in the past, or reconsider your role within a team. Venus retrograde in the 11th can bring old collaborations back for review—this time, you can set clearer terms. Mars–Jupiter in the 8th highlight shared projects, budgets, or research-heavy work. It’s a strong day for strategic planning meetings, revisiting business partnerships, or looking honestly at whether your current path supports the future you talk about.

❤️ Love: Your relationships are intertwined with your larger vision. If attached, discussions may revolve around shared dreams, money, or deeper emotional transparency. Topics like merging resources, long-term commitments, or healing old trust issues may arise; move slowly and listen as much as you speak. If single, you could feel drawn to someone linked to your social circle or an online community, but there may be complexity—distance, timing, or unresolved past ties. Let genuine emotional depth, not intensity alone, guide you.

💰 Money: The 8th-house activation makes joint finances, debts, inheritances, or partner income more prominent. This is a sensible day to review loans, insurance, or shared investments. Mars with exalted Jupiter supports taking action, but demands responsibility; make sure you understand the long-term implications of any commitment. The 11th-house Sun–Venus can indicate gains through networks or side projects, but also social spending; choose which events or causes truly deserve your contribution.

🧘 Advice: Dream out loud, but also be willing to run the numbers—your optimism is most powerful when it’s backed by structure.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you align your future plans with the reality of your resources and energy, hope stops feeling fragile and starts feeling solid.
capricorn:
♑ Capricorn

🔥 Energy: The Libra Sun with retrograde Venus and Mercury stands at the top of your chart in the 10th house, highlighting career, status and responsibility. Mars with exalted Jupiter in Cancer energize your 7th house of partnerships, while your ruler Saturn retrograde in Pisces refines your 3rd house of thinking and communication. Today has a strong “leadership under review” quality.

💼 Career: Visibility is high, but the universe is asking you to edit as much as to advance. The 10th-house focus puts your decisions and reputation in the spotlight; you may revisit an old role, client, or project. Venus retrograde can bring back previous professional themes for a second pass—this time, you can negotiate from greater self-knowledge. Mars–Jupiter in the 7th make key partners more assertive; some will energize you, others may challenge your stance. Aim for alliances where responsibilities and credit are clearly shared.

❤️ Love: Relationships are closely tied to your responsibilities now. If attached, discussions about career changes, public image or time demands may arise; be transparent about your pressures and invite your partner’s input instead of deciding alone. If single, you might feel drawn to serious, accomplished people through work or formal settings. Saturn in the 3rd encourages honest, calm conversations; superficial charm will likely feel hollow to you today.

💰 Money: Professional choices impact finances more strongly than usual. This could be a suitable time to revisit contract terms, salary structure, or how you price your services. Mars–Jupiter in the 7th highlight business agreements and shared ventures—be thorough with documentation and timelines. Saturn in the 3rd reminds you that clear written communication can prevent costly misunderstandings. Resist pressure to commit on the spot; asking for time to review details is a strength, not hesitation.

🧘 Advice: Measure success not only by what you take on, but by what you deliberately decline because it doesn’t match your integrity.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you lead from clear principles instead of fear of loss, the opportunities that remain are the ones truly meant for you.
aquarius:
♒ Aquarius

🔥 Energy: The Libra Sun with retrograde Venus and Mercury activates your 9th house of beliefs, learning and horizons, while Mars with exalted Jupiter in Cancer charges your 6th house of work and health. Saturn retrograde in your own sign continues its longer project of reshaping your identity. Today’s energy nudges you to adjust the story you live by so it matches the daily life you’re actually creating.

💼 Career: This is a strong day for planning, training and refining systems. The 9th-house focus encourages you to look beyond immediate tasks: where is your field heading, what skills will you need, and which mentors or courses could help? Venus retrograde suggests revisiting a past area of study or contact with someone who once inspired you. Meanwhile, Mars–Jupiter in the 6th give momentum to practical improvements—streamlining workflows, addressing a chronic inefficiency, or setting healthier boundaries around your availability.

❤️ Love: You’re more interested in shared worldview than surface chemistry today. If partnered, you might feel called to talk about ethics, spiritual beliefs, or long-term direction—conversations that reveal whether you’re growing in parallel. If single, you may be drawn to people from different cultures or intellectual backgrounds, perhaps through classes or online forums. Be aware that with Venus retrograde, old ideals about love may resurface for review; update them based on who you are now, not who you were years ago.

💰 Money: Financially, attention goes to work routines and future opportunities. Investing in education, tools or travel that genuinely expand your competence is favored, provided you run the numbers realistically. Mars–Jupiter in the 6th can also tempt you to overwork in the name of gain; remember that burnout is expensive in its own way. Review any beliefs you hold about money—scarcity, unworthiness, or magical thinking—and notice how they shape everyday choices.

🧘 Advice: Let your daily schedule reflect your philosophy; otherwise your beliefs are just decoration.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The more your habits line up with what you say you value, the less you need to convince anyone—your life becomes the proof.
pisces:
♓ Pisces

🔥 Energy: The Libra Sun with retrograde Venus and Mercury travels through your 8th house of shared resources, intimacy and transformation, while Mars with exalted Jupiter in Cancer lights up your 5th house of joy, creativity and children. Your ruler Jupiter is strong but intense here, and Saturn retrograde in your own sign keeps you aware of your limits. Today’s waters are deep but potentially healing.

💼 Career: Behind-the-scenes alliances and complex projects may demand attention. The 8th-house emphasis favors work involving research, finance, client confidentiality, or restructuring. You might revisit an old arrangement with a partner, investor or employer, aiming to make it more equitable. Mars–Jupiter in the 5th bring a surge of creative courage—this is excellent for pitching ideas, designing something new, or taking on a visible task that showcases your talents. Just ensure you’re not overpromising in enthusiasm; Saturn in your sign prefers realistic commitments.

❤️ Love: Emotional honesty is highlighted. In existing relationships, conversations about vulnerability, trust and shared fears can deepen closeness if approached gently. The combination of 8th- and 5th-house energy can intensify passion, but also bring old insecurities to the surface—see them as invitations to grow rather than proof something is wrong. If single, you may be drawn to magnetic, complex people or someone met through creative or spiritual circles. Take your time; let their consistency impress you before you hand over your heart.

💰 Money: Shared finances, inheritances, taxes or debts may come into focus today. Sun–Venus in the 8th are ideal for reviewing agreements, spotting fees, or planning how to reduce a burden over time. Mars–Jupiter in the 5th can stir speculative urges—riskier investments, gambling, or big spending on fun. Channel that energy into calculated, modest moves rather than all-or-nothing bets. You can also invest in your own creativity: tools, lessons or experiences that help a talent become a more reliable resource.

🧘 Advice: Meet intensity with grounded kindness toward yourself; not every strong feeling requires an immediate decision.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you stop treating your depth as something to hide or rush through, it turns from chaos into your clearest source of strength.
